title: SEDALCO Construction, Ridgemont Construction, and HMI Company Integrate Splash Tents into Corporate Events and More | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
These construction companies have one major thing in common - they’ve all trusted Splash Tents to provide branded tents for trade shows, employee functions, and more.
SEDALCO Construction, Ridgemont Construction, and HMI Company all have one thing in common - they have entrusted Splash Tents to provide custom, branded tents and more for corporate events.
While SEDALCO Construction, Ridgemont Construction, and HMI Company serve their industry with various services and products, all three of these premier construction companies have chosen to work with Splash Tents. Splash Tents, a Dallas-based SMB, offers an unparalleled level of craftsmanship and service with its offering of high quality, branded tents, corporate signage, flags, custom sized tablecloths, step repeat walls and more. Splash Tents debuted in 2009 and continues to forge ahead as a trusted partner for branded products.
SEDALCO Construction provides world-class construction projects with relationships at its core. HMI Company provides industry leading concrete raising equipment, material, and support, and Ridgemont Construction offers leading construction management hinging on responsiveness and quality in service.
Splash Tents has provided SEDALCO Construction, Ridgemont Construction, and HMI Company with a wealth of branded products including full bleed digital 10x10 tents as well as 10x15 tents, full backdrops with digital graphics, digitally printed table covers, and flags to draw attention and traffic. The flags offer versatile use and can be hoisted atop tents or placed next to tents using spikes or concrete stands. All three companies use Splash Tents custom branded tents and other gear for their tradeshow events, workers in the field, marketing campaigns, and more.
Splash Tents is especially proud to serve American-based businesses such as SEDALCO Construction, Ridgemont Construction, and HMI Company. Through partnerships such as these, Splash Tents helps companies of all sizes gain more traffic and sales. Learn more about these pioneering construction companies by visiting https://www.sedalco.com/ , https://hmicompany.com/ , and https://ridgemont.com/ .
Learn more about Splash Tents by visiting https://www.splashtents.com/ .
ABOUT SPLASH TENTS
Since 2009, Splash Tents has been a trusted provider of high-quality, customized products designed to elevate branding and event displays. With over 3,000 satisfied clients, including not-for-profits, car dealerships, consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies, oil and gas firms, tech companies, schools and universities, and the sports industry, Splash Tents has built a diverse and loyal customer base. Their expertise in delivering tailored solutions for various industries has made them a go-to choice for businesses and organizations looking to make a lasting impact at events.
Splash Tents offers a wide range of products designed to enhance visibility and professionalism at any event. Their offerings include branded tents, trade show displays, banners, table covers, signage, and more. All products are crafted with high-quality, durable materials that can withstand both outdoor and indoor conditions, ensuring that clients can rely on them for multiple events and uses.
What sets Splash Tents apart is their dedication to providing reasonable prices without compromising on quality. The company believes that professional, impactful branding solutions should be accessible to organizations of all sizes and budgets. They work closely with clients to offer customized solutions that meet their specific needs while staying within budget, making it easy for businesses and organizations to enhance their visibility and branding without overspending.
In addition to their top-notch products, Splash Tents is known for its exceptional customer service. Their team is committed to ensuring that every client’s needs are met with professionalism and care, offering expert advice and support throughout the design and ordering process. With nearly two decades of experience, Splash Tents continues to be a trusted partner for organizations across a variety of industries.
